name: loader
title: Loader
description: A spinning loading indicator with configurable pixel size, stroke width, and color.

docs.lead: A spinning loading indicator with configurable pixel size, stroke width, and color.

examples.title: Sizes
examples.description: Pass any pixel value to the size prop for precise control.

examples.title: Colors
examples.description: Supports all semantic color tokens. Use 'current' to inherit from the parent text color.
examples.code:
<Loader.Root color="primary" />
<Loader.Root color="neutral" />
<Loader.Root color="error" />
<Loader.Root color="success" />
<Loader.Root color="warning" />
<Loader.Root color="white" />

examples.title: Inline
examples.description: Use a small size with the 'current' color to place loaders inline with text.
examples.code: Fetching results...

examples.title: Custom Stroke Width
examples.description: Override the auto-calculated stroke width for thinner or thicker arcs.
examples.code:
<Loader.Root size={32} strokeWidth={2} />
<Loader.Root size={32} strokeWidth={4} />
<Loader.Root size={32} strokeWidth={6} />

props.name: size
props.description: The size of the loader in pixels

props.name: strokeWidth
props.description: The stroke width of the spinner arcs. Auto-calculated from size if not provided.

props.name: color
props.description: The color of the loader. Use 'current' to inherit from parent text color.
